I have farmed this small piece of land since I was a young girl, and I learned everything from my mother and father. I do not have cash to buy chemical fertilizer from the cooperative — one bag is too expensive and too big for only 0.21 hectares — so I will spread cow manure on it like I always do. I will plant my own saved seed, not the new kind from the market, because I know it grows here and I do not want to borrow money. My family and I will do all the work with our own hands; this plot is small enough that we do not need to hire anyone, and I think we will spend about twenty-five days on it from planting to harvest.
